## About Sun City Summerlin

Sun City Summerlin is a 55+ community by Del Webb in Las Vegas, Nevada. Part of the Summerlin master-planned community, this Sun City neighborhood is nestled within the Spring Mountain Range at an elevation of 3,000 feet. 7,779 attached and single-family homes make up Sun City Summerlin.

Active adult homebuyers looking for a low-maintenance lifestyle and world-class amenities in Las Vegas, NV should consider Sun City Summerlin homes for sale in their search.

## **Sun City Summerlin Amenities**

Sun City Summerlin boasts a vast array of amenities for homeowners to enjoy. Four clubhouses that house a variety of resort-style amenities are the center of this amenities collection.

The Mountain Shadows Clubhouse at Sun City Summerlin includes an indoor spa, exercise room, and a table tennis area. Here residents can enjoy six tennis courts, four shuffleboard courts, a racquetball court, an outdoor track, and more.
Residents can also brush up on their putting skills on the mini golf course or catch up with neighbors in the picnic area.

The Desert Vista Community Center is a 44,000-square-foot facility that is home to a grand ballroom with a dance floor and stage, as well as a fitness center and an aerobics studio. The activities continue outside with a pool and spa, four bocce ball courts, two pickleball courts, and four lighted tennis courts.

Swimmers in Sun City Summerlin can take advantage of the Sun Shadows Clubhouse, which is home to the community's Olympic-size indoor pool and spa. This clubhouse also acts as a meeting place for neighbors with several multipurpose rooms and card rooms, as well as an aerobics studio for staying in shape. Outdoors, the Sun Shadows Clubhouse is home to four bocce ball courts.

Highland Falls, Palm Valley, and Eagle Crest offer 54 holes of golf within the community. Residents enjoy preferred tee times and rates. Some of the best mountain views in the valley from the fairways.

### Four Recreation Centers

Mountain Shadows, Desert Vista, Sun Shadows, and Pinnacle provide 120,000+ square feet of pools, fitness, ballrooms, arts studios, woodworking shops, and meeting rooms.

### 100+ Chartered Clubs

One of the most active social calendars of any 55+ community in the country. Clubs for every interest from pickleball to photography to travel groups to theater.

### Red Rock Canyon Access

The western edge of Sun City Summerlin borders Red Rock Canyon with direct trail access from the community. Hiking and biking without leaving the neighborhood.

### Adjacent to Downtown Summerlin

125+ shops and restaurants at Downtown Summerlin are a five-minute drive. Summerlin Hospital Medical Center is immediately adjacent to the community.

### Proven 35-Year Track Record
Built starting in 1989, Sun City Summerlin has a 35-year track record of stable property values, settled HOAs, and a proven community governance model.

# Sun City Summerlin Homes for Sale: Complete Guide 2026

Sun City Summerlin is Nevada’s largest 55-plus active adult community, with more than 7,200 homes across 2,800 acres in the northwest Las Vegas Valley. Opened by Del Webb in 1989, the community consistently ranks among the top retirement destinations in the U.S. – buyers in 2026 can find resale homes priced from the low $400,000s to over $1 million, supported by four recreation centers, three championship golf courses, and Nevada’s zero state income tax advantage.
